## Findings

1. **High — repository clean/process filters still provide command execution**

   The new hardening only disables `core.fsmonitor` and `log.showSignature` in [`internal/gitutil/git.go:865`](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/21310117052ac5d680eefe8637f93b02b9a877ad/internal/gitutil/git.go#L865-L876). Normal worktree search still invokes `git status` at [`internal/gitutil/worktree.go:64`](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/21310117052ac5d680eefe8637f93b02b9a877ad/internal/gitutil/worktree.go#L64-L65), reached by the cacheability check at [`internal/sem/search_cache.go:146`](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/21310117052ac5d680eefe8637f93b02b9a877ad/internal/sem/search_cache.go#L146).

   A tracked `.gitattributes` can select a filter driver whose `clean` or long-running `process` command is defined in repository config; Git runs these commands during content conversion. [Git documents both filter mechanisms](https://git-scm.com/docs/gitattributes).

   Independent reproduction at the exact PR head:

   ```text
   .gitattributes:       *.go filter=evil
   filter.evil.clean:   touch MARKER; cat
   filter.evil.required: false
   ```

   After making a tracked Go file stat-dirty without changing its contents:

   - The PR’s exact hardened `git status` command created `MARKER`.
   - A normal `entire-graph search --repo FIXTURE ...` also created it.
   - `filter.evil.process` was independently confirmed to launch as well.
   - `required=false` affects failure handling; it does not prevent execution.

   Impact: indexing a repository with untrusted local Git configuration still permits code execution, contradicting the PR’s stated security objective and its assertion that the remaining Git argument vectors were audited.

   Recommended correction:

   - Immediately remove this `git status` probe from the trust boundary—make `worktreeSnapshotCacheable` conservatively return false when safety cannot be established.
   - For a durable cache solution, compare contained raw worktree bytes with HEAD/index blobs using plumbing that cannot apply filters.
   - Add regression coverage for both `filter.<driver>.clean` and `filter.<driver>.process`.

   Enumerating and blacklisting current driver names is not robust: attributes and driver names are dynamic, configuration can come from multiple scopes/includes, and enumeration followed by execution creates a race.

2. **Low/advisory — fsmonitor regression test can falsely skip**

   [`git_hardening_test.go:66`](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/blob/21310117052ac5d680eefe8637f93b02b9a877ad/internal/gitutil/git_hardening_test.go#L66-L78) stores an unquoted temporary script path in `core.fsmonitor`. Any missing marker is then labeled “unsupported Git.”
